title_ru: Кот к Ауре — Mendes CG 53469, базальная масса, мошонка/яички и золотые оболочки
question: Where should the Cat search next for the connected Osiris genital bundle: phallus, possible scrotal/testicular component, and gold covers/shells?

cards.what_cat_carries: BROKEN_GOLD_SKIN — the Cat carries a gold skin/shell; inspect what was under it and what attached to it
cards.where_to_sniff: BACK_OF_PLATE — inspect reverse, base, seams, rolled edges, backing and attachment traces
cards.what_are_the_eggs: ATTACHED_BASAL_ELEMENT — first test whether the 'eggs' are already represented by the crumpled basal mass of CG 53469
cards.cat_exit: FOLLOW_CONSERVATOR — next guide is conservation/object documentation

primary_route.instruction: Resolve current object card, high-resolution multi-view photographs, direct measurements, same-sheet versus attached element, seams/folds/support traces, repair history, and any X-ray/CT/XRF/microscopy/3D records.

secondary_route.instruction: Reconstruct JE 35420–35425 and nearby Mendes 1902 accessions; search neutral labels such as ornament, foil, fitting, cover, fragment, amulet and insert for paired/rounded/pouch-like or genital-adjacent gold elements.

execution_order: sealed Osirian reliquaries only if Mendes branch resolves negative
